about: Hand-reviewed tags for every reference. Keys are a phone photo's file in public/photos-ref, or 'ref:<path>' for a file in the private villacana-reference repo. shows: area ids from data/areas.json (what the picture shows, not where the camera stood). viewpoint: ground, upper-floor, roof, aerial or map. useFor: topic ids from data/areas.json. looksAt: [x, z] map metres of the picture's main subject, and subject: a few words naming it (set them for roof shots and for photos you build from; otherwise the builder estimates a point along the heading). note: anything an agent must know before using it. Do not put API keys, signed URLs or photo metadata here: this repo is public.

ref:apple-maps/11-3d-guillermo-slope-to-.note: Dave, 2026-10-21. The lane runs down continuously from the restaurant's west end to the paseo between the house gardens and a long white wall on the pool-lawn side; the wall's lawn face gets lower towards the sea. Calle Jorge joins part-way down with no visible steps. The single-storey white kiosk at the foot stands at lawn and paseo level; the lane passes west of it to the beach gate and zebra crossing. Heights are not measurable from the mesh.

Not a wide flight off the restaurant roof.
